capabilities.title: Camera
capabilities.summary: Capture a photo with permission from the device owner.

capabilities.title: Photo picker
capabilities.summary: Choose specific photos using the system picker.

capabilities.title: Barcode and QR scanner
capabilities.summary: Scan a code in a dedicated camera workflow.

capabilities.title: Document picker
capabilities.summary: Import a document selected by the device owner.

capabilities.title: PDF report
capabilities.summary: Generate a local report; this does not provide a general PDF viewer.

capabilities.title: PDF viewer
capabilities.summary: Open supported HTTPS or local file PDFs.

capabilities.title: Signature and drawing
capabilities.summary: Capture ink or a signature; storing it is a separate data decision.

capabilities.title: Current location
capabilities.summary: Request a foreground location fix, not continuous tracking.

capabilities.title: Background location
capabilities.summary: Continuous tracking requires explicit permission and an approved storage/upload scope.

capabilities.title: Device authentication
capabilities.summary: Use the device's available local authentication methods.

capabilities.title: Date and time picker
capabilities.summary: Use the platform date/time control in a form.

capabilities.title: Share sheet
capabilities.summary: Let the device owner share an app-generated local file.

capabilities.title: Email draft
capabilities.summary: Open a local email draft. Server-side sends require an approved connector.

capabilities.title: Audio
capabilities.summary: Record or play audio using the shipped native module.

capabilities.title: Video
capabilities.summary: Play video using the shipped native module.

capabilities.title: Secure storage
capabilities.summary: Store app secrets through the platform's secure storage.

capabilities.title: Local files
capabilities.summary: Manage app-owned files without adding a remote data source.

capabilities.title: Clipboard
capabilities.summary: Copy or read clipboard content as part of an explicit user action.

capabilities.title: Screen orientation
capabilities.summary: Use the orientations supported by the installed app configuration.

capabilities.title: Device information
capabilities.summary: Read supported device metadata without collecting a device-owner identity.

capabilities.title: Device sensors
capabilities.summary: Use only sensors exposed by the installed package and device.

capabilities.title: Haptic feedback
capabilities.summary: Not enabled by this mobile runtime policy; use visual feedback.
